name: Idle Farm Online
storyline: Deep beneath the town, a network of caves descends one hundred floors into darkness, each level home to stronger monsters and a powerful boss. Adventurers gather in the town to trade, form guilds and prepare before venturing down, while rival hunters and timed invasions make every expedition a risk.
summary: Idle Farm Online is a free-to-play pixel art idle MMORPG. Players create a character, choose a weapon class (sword, bow, staff or claw) and descend through 100 cave floors filled with monsters and bosses. Characters can hunt automatically with a configurable bot, so progress continues while the player does other things. The game features PvP with a skull and prison system, an optional PvE mode per map, guilds, timed events such as the Invasion (six times a day), equipment with rarities, upgrades and gem slots, the Chaos Machine for combining items, and a player market. It is cross-platform, with shared servers for Android, Windows and web browsers, and is available in Portuguese.
